facts.fact: The Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD) launched the new version of the national open data portal on 2021-12-13, in Arabic and French, as part of implementing the Open Data action plan and Morocco's open government commitments.
On the relaunch the ADD reports about 43% more datasets published and 31% more bodies producing open data, giving no absolute counts; the portal gives access to data from several public bodies.

systems.owner: Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD), with World Bank support
ADD, with a national Open Data steering committee

note: The document names an Open Data action plan but gives no adoption date or instrument, so no standing fact.
